Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a cohesive six-icon asset sheet for a premium dark native Windows connection utility. Landscape image 3:2, exactly 3 columns by 2 rows with perfectly equal square cells; six fully separated icons centered within their own cell with generous padding and no overlap. Entire background truly transparent. Row 1 left to right: 1) two curved mint arrows forming a circle for refresh cache, 2) a mint checkmark in a transparent circular lens for diagnose connection, 3) a small glass folder with mint plus sign for import server. No words, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no UI panels, no frames around cells, no watermark. Artwork must remain fully inside each cell, no icon touching the square cell edges.
